title: Mum's Oldest — EN/IT/DE (Wilma McIvor)
style: folk country acoustic guitar warm female vocal 98bpm brushed drums gentle storytelling English Italian German language learning trilingual
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
He came first, and that changes a person
You carry the weight of the ones who come after
I watched him on rooftops and I held my breath
But he was sure-footed, always was

[Verse 2 — Italiano]
Quando chiamò per dire che comprava la barca [When he rang to say he was buying the boat]
Preparai una tazza di tè e mi sedetti un po' [I made a cup of tea and sat for a while]
Tuo padre rise — certo che sì, certo che sì [Your father laughed — of course he did, of course]
È il ragazzo che non è mai rimasto fermo, per me [That's the boy who never stayed still, for me]

[Chorus — English]
My oldest one, the one who led the way
My oldest one, I see him in the early day
Standing at the water, looking for the line
My oldest one — I'm glad you're doing fine

[Bridge — Deutsch]
Mein ältester Sohn schaut auf den Horizont [My oldest son looks at the horizon]
Er hat immer gewusst, wohin er musste [He always knew where he needed to go]
Der Garten wächst noch, das Leben geht weiter [The garden is still growing, life goes on]
Mein ältester Sohn — ich bin so stolz auf dich [My oldest son — I am so proud of you]

[Verse 3 — English]
He runs his boats and I run my garden
Different kinds of captain, same steady hands

[Outro — EN/IT/DE]
The gardens still growing
Il giardino sta ancora crescendo [The garden is still growing]
Der Garten wächst noch [The garden is still growing]
My oldest one
